text: To distribute your application to differentplatforms, how many Java versions do YOUneed to create?

summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of an educational app focused on learning Java. The screen is titled "Introduction to Java" and presents a multiple-choice question. The question asks, "To distribute your application to different platforms, how many Java versions do you need to create?" There are three answer options provided:

1. One for each platform
2. Just one version
3. Two versions

At the bottom of the screen, there is a green "CHECK" button for submitting the selected answer. The top of the screen includes navigation elements such as a back arrow, progress indicator (showing 1/2), and options to unlock more content or share the question. The time is displayed in the top right corner.
